title: Book Two · Chapter 103: The Short Visit
story:
On Tuesday, Ronan reaches the materials room during the morning break. The teacher in charge has a pile of books on a chair. She moves them one at a time onto a high shelf.

“May I ask about our guide?” Ronan says.

“In a moment. Please leave the doorway clear.”

Ronan steps to the side. He holds the old sheet behind his notebook. The teacher takes another book from the chair.

Two younger pupils arrive with a broken folder. The loose sheets fall across the floor. Ronan catches one with his shoe, then picks it up.

“Thank you,” the teacher says.

She turns to the younger pupils. Their folder needs a new tie. The break bell rings before she finishes.

Ronan looks at the old sheet. He can ask one quick question now. But a boy from his class calls from the stairs.

“Come on. We need to be in our seats.”

Ronan puts the sheet away. He leaves. He still does not know the opening time.

At lunch, Jun has a small book open on the table. It is his own book of trees. A young pupil beside him points to a picture.

“I can bring this next Wednesday,” Jun tells the pupil. “Then we can use a school picture sheet, too. We need the big leaf picture.”

Ronan sits down.

“Did you ask?” Jun says.

“I went there.”

“Did the teacher check Wednesday?”

The young pupil looks up. Ronan feels his face grow warm. Jun has the book list ready. Mei has nearly finished her picture. His own part is one short line.

“Yes,” Ronan says. “Wednesday after lunch.”

Jun takes a pencil and writes the time beside the leaf picture in his notes.

“Good. Then I can tell him.”

The younger pupil smiles. “I will come.”

Ronan opens his lunch. The lid makes a small click against the table. He does not look at the boy.

Later, Miss Wu passes their table. Jun shows her the list.

“Ronan checked the time,” he says. “Mei's picture will be ready tomorrow.”

“Good,” she says. “Bring me a full sample on Friday.”

Ronan nods with Jun. He has until Friday. He could go back to the materials room and ask. Perhaps Wednesday really is the right day. Then Jun may never learn about the lie.

After school, he walks past the passage. The door is closed. He feels the corner of the old sheet through his bag.

At home he copies the opening line in his neatest writing. He leaves out the question mark.

The word Wednesday fills the space very well.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

sample＝样本；checked＝核对过；leave out＝省去；neat＝工整的。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan实际问到开放时间了吗？
2. Jun根据他的回答做了什么安排？

## 读句子

**Ronan / opens / his lunch.** Ronan／打开／他的午饭盒。
